\section*{Question 1}

A particle moves in the \(x y\)-plane so that its position at any time \(t\), for \(-\pi \leq t \leq \pi\), is given by \(x(t)=\sin (3 t)\) and \(y(t)=2 t\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Sketch the path of the particle in the \(x y\)-plane provided. Indicate the direction of motion along the path.
\item[(b)] Find the range of \(x(t)\) and the range of \(y(t)\).
\item[(c)] Find the smallest positive value of \(t\) for which the \(x\)-coordinate of the particle is a local maximum. What is the speed of the particle at this time?
\item[(d)] Is the distance traveled by the particle from \(t=-\pi\) to \(t=\pi\) greater than \(5 \pi\) ? Justify your answer.
\item[(a)]

\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& -1 \leq x(t) \leq 1 \\
& -2 \pi \leq y(t) \leq 2 \pi
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& x^{\prime}(t)=3 \cos 3 t=0 \\
& \qquad 3 t=\frac{\pi}{2} ; t=\frac{\pi}{6} \\
& \text { Speed }=\sqrt{9 \cos ^{2}(3 t)+4} \\
& \text { At } t=\frac{\pi}{6} \\
& \text { Speed }=\sqrt{9 \cos ^{2}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)+4}=2
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(d)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Distance } & =\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} \sqrt{9 \cos ^{2}(3 t)+4} d t \\
& =17.973>5 \pi
\end{aligned}
\]
\end{itemize}
